C0343.title: Scalpers Use Automated Scripts to Mass-Register Accounts for Snatching Sneakers and Concert Tickets
C0343.summary: Scalpers deployed automated scripts to complete registration, login, and purchase processes within 0.8 seconds. By forging 17 different device IDs and bypassing CAPTCHA, they mass-registered accounts to snatch limited-edition sneakers and concert tickets, reselling them at inflated prices on other platforms after official sell-outs. The total amount involved reached 327 million yuan.
